intro: Questions that must be answered before any decision can reasonably be made. Each entry says what we already have and what is missing.

questions.question: What is the intended ASIN for each supplied short link?
questions.have: Resolved destinations for all five links (F01).
questions.missing: Owner confirmation of intent. The short-link codes are 9 characters, so they cannot be read as ASINs.
questions.how_to_answer: Owner confirms the five ASINs, or confirms that the observed ones are correct.

questions.question: Is shopnow047c-20 an active Associates tracking ID, and under which account?
questions.have: The ID as supplied. Program Policies §2(b) names the ID format as XXXXX-## 'or such other format as we may designate'.
questions.missing: Confirmation of enrollment and account ownership. Not verifiable from the sandbox.
questions.how_to_answer: Owner checks the Associates account (Tools / Reports).

questions.question: Do the supplied short links attribute clicks to the tracking ID?
questions.have: Observed redirect targets without a tag parameter (F03).
questions.missing: A test click per product and the tracking report result.
questions.how_to_answer: Run one test click per product through the Associates workflow; record date, destination and the report line.

questions.question: Will the site be enrolled in PA-API or Creators API so prices and ratings can be shown?
questions.how_to_answer: Owner checks API access in the Associates account.

questions.question: What are the five click and conversion events to record?
questions.have: Only the count (five) from the brief.

questions.question: Where should a click counter or analytics endpoint run?
questions.missing: A host that can run an endpoint, and a privacy stance.
questions.how_to_answer: Owner chooses one option on D3.

questions.question: Who is the named author or editor for articles?
questions.missing: Author name, role, and short bio the owner approves.

questions.question: Should the site use a custom domain or the GitHub Pages address?
questions.have: GitHub Pages can publish from this repository.

questions.question: What is the brand name?
questions.how_to_answer: Owner confirms or replaces the name.

questions.question: What publishing cadence should guides follow?
questions.have: The brief asks for a cadence but gives no number.
questions.missing: Frequency and the first publication date.

questions.question: Does the account meet the current enrollment rule?
questions.have: A secondary-source claim of 3 qualifying sales in 180 days (FLG-10).
questions.missing: Confirmation of the current rule and the account's status.

questions.question: Which of the four working titles should become guides?
questions.missing: A choice. Titles are not findings.

questions.question: Do the brief's identifiers (FLG-003, S01, S02, S07, S24, SG-27..SG-30) refer to documents you have?
questions.have: Only the references in the brief.
questions.how_to_answer: Owner provides the source register or confirms the public documents used here (FLG-07).

questions.question: Which first-party reports will feed the campaign ledger?
questions.missing: Authorized report exports and their dates.
questions.how_to_answer: Owner names the report and export schedule.

questions.question: Has counsel reviewed the disclosure wording?
questions.have: Disclosure text tied to Operating Agreement §5 and FTC guidance.
